title: Split init credentials into tenant-scoped templates and introduce sparse-values overlay plus rollback-lease annotation
author: Priya Kaur
description: Motivation: private deployments scale by tenant and merge conflicts in giant values.yaml files were making upgrades risky. This PR decomposes the large init credentials templating into tenant-scoped partials, adds a sparse-values overlay mechanism so operators can supply minimal per-tenant overrides stored separately, and implements a lightweight rollback-lease annotation to prevent concurrent rollback races during cluster upgrade waves. Changes include a validated values.schema.json extension for sparse overlays, new Helm helpers to render tenant secrets only when present, an init quiesce hook that sequences pre-upgrade drain signals, and a tiny admission-style annotation template for rollback lease coordination. Migration: existing installs continue to work unchanged; operators who adopt sparse overlays should follow the README steps to move per-tenant overrides into charts/private/values-override/<tenant>.yaml. Testing: unit schema tests, helm template smoke, and an e2e upgrade dry-run on our canary cluster. Rollout plan: merge to main, release patch chart v1.12.3, enable opt-in in private-installer with a flag. No data migration required.
commits: a1b3f7c: introduce charts/private/values-override directory and README with usage guide
b2c4d5e: add charts/private/templates/_tenant-credentials.tpl helper and split init-credentials.yaml into tenant-scoped include
c3d6e7f: add values.schema.json extensions for sparse overlays and validate with helm unittest
d4e8f9a: add init-quiesce-hook template and sequencing annotation support
e5f0a1b: implement rollback-lease annotation template and unit test to prevent double rollback
f6a1b2c: update Chart.yaml and README; fix linting issues raised by CI
review_comments: Elliot Zhao requested changes: please add explicit unit tests covering empty overlay and overlay with only secretRef; also prefer using include instead of required to avoid template failures when no tenant overrides exist.
Author (Priya Kaur) reply: added unit tests and switched to include helpers; updated values.schema.json to mark overlay as optional and added examples in values-override/README.md.

Noah Bennett comment: the rollback-lease pattern is clever but please document failure-mode: what happens if lease annotation persists after successful rollback? asked for a short cleanup job to remove stale leases.

Author reply: added optional cleanup hook (no-op by default) and documented cleanup guidance; emphasized that leases are advisory and the init controller will treat stale leases older than 'leaseTTL' as expired.
Sofia Alvarez approval: tested on canary cluster, verified that tenant-scoped secrets are only rendered when override exists and that quiesce hook orders jobs correctly. Approve+1.
release_notes: Helm chart: private - split init credential templating into tenant-scoped includes; add optional sparse-values overlay support for per-tenant minimal values; add init-quiesce hook to sequence service quiescing during upgrades; add rollback-lease annotation and optional cleanup hook. Operators should consult charts/private/values-override/README.md for migration steps.
